scope: BG blocked U Task1 offline candidate

findings.title: Successful arithmetic-to-commit coverage is conditional and support-fill/reuse coverage is absent
findings.detail: The only full arithmetic->commit->dense/incidence comparison accepts :store_budget instead at lines158-170. Thus a regression rejecting every ordinary applied panel bypasses the promised representation checks. Later positive commits force phase=0x02 without running arithmetic; the single changed-support accepted test deletes a slot. Require a deliberately bounded successful arithmetic commit unconditionally, positive fill-in with exact sorted stable-ID incidence, and a second successful panel using the workspace. Assert unchanged owners and exact changed-array lengths/owners, outside-band preservation, and one merge per affected column.

findings.title: Predecision, history-action, touched-mask and signed-zero structural oracles are incomplete
findings.detail: The independent dictionary oracle records only row/swap/multiplier, not current predecision a/z bits. The test omits last field and never checks forward/transposed action of recorded history or touched masks. Both carrier and oracle discard all exact input zeros; the subnormal test checks a nonzero output, not signed/underflow-zero behavior. Add independent per-step predecision capture in cold/probe mode only, validate chronological original-format history action including last, compare both masks, and add focused absent-source target-preservation and signed/underflow-zero cases. Full original-B/lower/API tests stay Task2.

findings.title: Exact movement-guard and complete source-work tests do not exercise computed commit counts
findings.detail: The exact-cap and cap+1 tests invoke _bgb_store_budget directly. They cannot detect a wrong planned-store formula in _bgb_commit!. Existing long-prefix tests are not exact boundary fixtures. Require constructed real commits at exactly 2*h*w and one store above, with no reserve/mutation/allocation on refusal; verify actual/planned stores, copied prefix/suffix reads, all-column merges, and eligibility/gather separate traversals with independently derived expected counters. Existing counters assert selected fields only; h*w incidence-mask and scratch checks require concrete coverage rather than source comments.
